arguments.text: Verified work.py against the current Stage 3 contract. Ordered layers preserve explicit false, zero, and empty strings; null resets only when null_resets is exactly true; unknown layer keys return unknown_key before later checks; environment overrides require environment=true, known keys, exact lowercase true/false for booleans, and ASCII signed decimal strings for integers; final exact-type validation occurs after all overrides and rejects booleans as integers. Boundary probes for repair by later layers/environment, disabled/empty environment, whitespace and Unicode digits all matched expectations. report.json matches evaluating current requests.json with policy.json.
Unresolved limits: malformed request/policy container shapes and policy type names beyond boolean, integer, and string are outside the tested contract and intentionally unspecified.
